input.reasoning: A status banner on the page says "Issue "Checkout fails on Safari" created with label bug.", but the issues list doesn't back it up. The filters are unrestricted (Status: All, Label: Any, empty search), and the table shows only the three original issues: Login button misaligned, Add dark mode and Typo in docs. The count reads "3 issues". If the issue had really been created, it would appear in this full list. So the first expected outcome (a new issue with that title exists) can't be confirmed from the final state and appears false, and the bug label can't be checked on an issue that isn't there. The banner alone isn't enough evidence, especially since it contradicts the data.
